D 4773. ASSISTANCE TO SPECIAL BRANCH
18.4.33 HEADQUARTERS, ON COMMUNIST
RAID.

No. 8
00-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. PH. REGISTRY.
N. D 4773
Kashing Road Station
Date 17th April 193

Subject (in full) Assistance to Special Branch, Headquarters, on Communist Raid.

Made by D.S. 84 Heanly, Forwarded by D.C.I. Palmer.

Sir,
At 11 p.m. on 17.4.33, D.C.I. Duncan attached to the Special
Branch, Headquarters, came to this Station and requested that a
representative of this Station accompany him to House 39, Lane 182
Urga Road to search the room above the kitchen there and arrest any
persons found adhering to the Communist cause, C.I.D. Court Warrants
Nos. 7603 and 7604 having been obtained for that purpose.
Accordingly, C.D.C. 162 and the undersigned accompanied the
party to the above address, where it was found that the prior
occupants had moved some 8 days ago to an unknown address, the room
being unoccupied and empty, no arrests therefore were made.

I am Sir,
Your obedient servant,
A. D. Heanly.
D.S. 84.

D. D. D. "C".

To Special Branch
52. Please note and pass
W Registry Office.
Reg. Passed SBR 18/4
